parent.rule: Parent segments are immutable in meaning; this segment appends new events only.

events.event: Created a privacy-minimized temporal/DAG protocol for family-system causal inference covering rotational work, rurality, bereavement, adult mental health, sexual-interest/offending distinction, child exposures, child mental-health outcomes and gender self-description as separate variables.
events.privacy_decision: The user-provided anecdotal family example was abstracted into a synthetic topology; no names, exact location, intimate child identity detail or unverified allegation against a specific adult was stored.
major_method_changes: preference/clinical state separated from offending behavior
child trauma/mental-health outcomes separated from gender identity/self-description
bereavement-to-paedophilic-disorder direct edge forbidden without specific evidence
all causal edges require evidence provenance, confounders, mediators, falsification test and claim ceiling
external_evidence_anchors: Work-family interface and child mental health review DOI 10.1186/s13034-023-00596-w
Acquired Pedophilia Delphi consensus and developmental-vs-acquired reviews
Rural child mental-health workforce review DOI 10.1111/ajr.13119
topa_kills: TGD/nonbinary identity proves abuse or mental disorder
child sexual offending proves paedophilic preference
events.claim_ceiling: The protocol can rank and falsify candidate causal pathways but cannot diagnose individuals or convert an anecdote into a population causal effect.
events.next_gate: Build longitudinal mediator-aware family-system evidence map and adult sexual-interest/offending differential evidence map.

events.event: Bound FAMILY-SYSTEM-TEMPORAL-CAUSAL-INFERENCE v1.0 into CURRENT_AUTHORITY v1.6; kept ABLI, identity coefficients and anecdote-derived causal coefficients frozen.
events.next_gate: P0.3 family-system causal evidence map + study-level SOGI matrix; no human experiment or main merge.
